Estimating population abundance in plant species
with dormant life-stages: Fire and the endangered
plant Grevillea caleyi R. Br.
By
Tony D. Auld and Judith Scott
Tony Auld and Judith Scott
are with the
Biodiversity Research Group of the Depart-
ment of Environment and Conservation
(NSW),
(PO Box 1967, Hurstville, NSW 2220,
Australia.
Email: tony.auld@npws.nsw.gov.au,
judy.scott@npws.nsw.gov.au
). The project is part
of the research and management arising from
the implementation of the recovery plan for the
endangered shrub, Grevillea caleyi.
Key words monitoring, plant ecology, population structure, sampling, soil seed bank, threatened
species.
